items.title: Pay vet invoice
items.computation: This is a private invoice, so the period is counted purely under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB from the stated start (invoice date), with no authority delivery-fiction involved. Start: invoice date 17.04.2026 (Rechnungsdatum); as an event-triggered period the day of the event itself is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Counting 14 days forward from 17.04.2026 lands on 01.05.2026 (17+14=31 → 31-30 days in April = day 1 of May). 01.05.2026 is a Friday and a nationwide public holiday (Tag der Arbeit). Since the payer resides in NW, the relevant holiday calendar is NW's, and 1 May counts there too. Under § 193 BGB, when the last day is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, the deadline moves to the next working day; because Saturday itself is one of the triggering days, the following Saturday (02.05.2026) and Sunday (03.05.2026) are likewise skipped, giving the next actual working day of Monday 04.05.2026.
